description: List all 169 UN SDG targets with their official descriptions. Optionally filter by goal number (1–17) to get only the targets for that goal. Each target has a code like "1.1", "3.3", or "13.2" that identifies it uniquely. Use target codes with unsdg.indicators.list to drill into specific measurement indicators.

goal.description: Filter by SDG goal number (e.g. "1" for No Poverty, "13" for Climate Action). If omitted, all 169 targets across all 17 goals are returned.

name: unsdg.targets.list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UN SDG Targets
